submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at a 35 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.249% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This significantly outperforms Algorithm-L2 (~85% efficiency) and Algorithm-L3 (~74% efficiency) across the tested threshold range. The 35 GeV threshold represents the optimal balance, as testing showed efficiency drops at both lower thresholds (90.937% at 30 GeV) and higher thresholds (90.152% at 40 GeV). All three candidate algorithms fit within FPGA resource budgets and optical link bandwidth, with no latency concerns documented for any algorithm, confirming compliance with the 4.0 us hard constraint. This recommendation is consistent with the 2025 simulation summary and maximizes physics reach for the new signature.
